newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Deutsche Telecom warrants open at NZ$0.32.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telecom warrants open at NZ$0.32.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG call warrants over the ordinary shares of Telecom Corp of New Zealand opened at 32 cents in their debut trading on Monday.

The Telecom call warrants are similar to call options, giving holders the right but not the obligation to buy shares in Telecom from Deutsche Bank at any time before the expiry date, at a price determined when the warrants are issued.
The warrants, which expire on September 23, 1998, allow investors to buy one Telecom share for every two warrants exercised at a cost of NZ$7.60 per share.
